original: 早く高校卒業したいなぁ。

en.text: I can't wait to graduate from high school.

original: どこの高校に行ってるの？

en.text: Where do you attend high school?
Where do you go to high school?
What high school do you go to?

original: あいつ、高校を中退したんだ。

en.text: He dropped out of high school.

original: うちのお兄ちゃん、高校の頃、手に負えない程の不良だったのよ。

en.text: My older brother was a real problem child in high school. Nobody could deal with him.

original: この本は、高校の時に読んだよ。

en.text: I read this book when I was in high school.
I read this book in high school.

original: 高校の時からここで働いてるんだ。

en.text: I've been working here since high school.

original: トムとは高校の時からの友達だよ。

en.text: Tom and I have been friends since high school.
